## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 423 captures during May 2023. This level of activity provides the basis for reviewing the timeliness and quality of the service during the month. Capture activity should continue to be recorded consistently so that changes in workload, image quality and grading outcomes can be monitored over time. Any operational matters affecting the capture process should be documented through the established service desk arrangements.

## Image quality

There were 15 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 3.5. These images could not be assessed for grading purposes and should be considered when reviewing the performance of the imaging process. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, with sufficient information to support follow-up and resolution. Ongoing attention to equipment and capture practice may help reduce the number of images that cannot be graded.

## Grading

A total of 105 results were graded referable during May 2023. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This indicates that grading was completed within a relatively short operational timeframe, while continued monitoring remains appropriate. Activity, image quality and grading data should be reviewed together to identify any emerging pressures and to support consistent service delivery at Harbour Eye Clinic.
